create_optimizer_momentum: create a Momentum optimizer with learning rate 0.01 and momentum 0.9 for SGD training
create_optimizer_nesterov: create a Momentum optimizer with Nesterov momentum enabled for accelerated convergence
apply_momentum_updates: apply momentum updates to a sequence of parameter tensors given gradient updates
compute_momentum_update: compute a momentum update for a single parameter tensor with learning rate and momentum scalar
apply_sparse_momentum_update: apply momentum updates to sparse IndexedSlices parameters with deduplicated indices
